name: grep
description:
Search file contents with a regular expression (ripgrep syntax), or plain text with `literal: true`. Honours .gitignore.
Returns `path:line:text`, at most 200 matches. Filter files with `include` (e.g. `*.ts`, `*.{ts,tsx}`).

path.description: File or directory to search (default: working directory)

literal.description: Match the pattern as plain text, not a regular expression
